source: Ballotpedia (ballotpedia.org) — Tier 2 corroboration source; acknowledged as a source per founder, 2026-09-22
method: One live FireCrawl scrape (maxAge 0, markdown, onlyMainContent) per district page; only the 'Candidates and election results > General election' block for Nov 3, 2026 was used. Withdrawn candidates listed in that block are included with withdrawn=true and excluded from the diff; '(Write-in)'-tagged entries are recorded in write_ins_noted and excluded from the diff. Party mapping: D=DEM, R=REP, L=LPF, 'No Party Affiliation'=NPA, 'Independent Party of Florida'=IND. Read-only: no database or repo edits.

races.notes: Ballotpedia page carries the disclaimer 'The candidate list in this election may not be complete.' All three of our candidates appear on Ballotpedia's Nov 3, 2026 general-election list with matching parties; names match exactly. Ballotpedia lists Kevin McClellan (No Party Affiliation) under 'Withdrawn or disqualified candidates' for the general election; he is not on our ballot, which is consistent. No write-ins listed for the 2026 general (the only write-in on the page, Shelley Fain, is in the 2022 special-election history). Incumbent per Ballotpedia: Wasserman Schultz.
